mapper.select: SELECT id, health_center_id, email, password, name, phone, role, active FROM members WHERE email = #{email} AND active = true
SELECT id, health_center_id, email, password, name, phone, role, active FROM members WHERE id = #{memberId} AND active = true

SELECT m.id, m.health_center_id, m.email, m.password, m.name, m.phone, m.role, m.active FROM refresh_tokens rt INNER JOIN members m ON m.id = rt.member_id WHERE rt.refresh_token = #{refreshToken} AND rt.revoked = false AND rt.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND m.active = true

SELECT m.id, m.health_center_id, m.email, m.password, m.name, m.phone, m.role, m.active FROM social_accounts sa INNER JOIN members m ON m.id = sa.member_id WHERE sa.provider = #{provider} AND sa.provider_user_id = #{providerUserId} AND m.active = true
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO members ( health_center_id, email, password, name, phone, role, active, created_at ) VALUES ( NULL, #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, '', 'CITIZEN', true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO social_accounts ( member_id, provider, provider_user_id, provider_email, linked_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{providerEmail}, #{linkedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (provider, provider_user_id) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO refresh_tokens ( member_id, refresh_token, expires_at, revoked, created_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{refreshToken}, #{expiresAt}, false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE refresh_token = #{refreshToken} AND revoked = false
